reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "For soccer, I'd open with light jogging or skips to get blood moving, then dynamic work: leg swings, walking lunges, lateral band walks, and single-leg glute bridges to wake up the hips and hamstrings. Finish with a few controlled landing drills, like jumping and sticking the landing, before any cutting or sprinting. That combo hits the muscles that protect the knee without beating you up before you play."}
